decisions.reason: The candidate already requires good foam quality and smooth high-speed mixing; calibrating whisk height is a configuration method owned by the source Requirement and does not change those acceptance criteria.
Whisk-height calibration for foam and splash performance does not change the independently stated quick, preferably tool-free removal behavior.

The candidate already requires controlled high-speed splashing and already lists whisk-position adjustment, bowl-depth adjustment, and a guard as possible methods; the source decision adds no new candidate state.
Whisk positioning for foam quality and splash reduction does not modify the candidate's bowl, spout, or whisk cleaning requirements.
The source positioning criterion concerns mixing performance; the separate bowl-removal clause from the same message is already represented by the candidate's existing message-73 MODIFY.
The source decision does not change the maximum speed, adjustment range, independent control, or normal operating-speed policy.
Whisk-height calibration is a mixing configuration detail and does not alter the candidate's general event-use reliability requirement.
The source decision concerns whisk behavior during mixing and does not change spout flow, dispensing sequence, sputtering, consistency preservation, or froth preservation during dispensing.
Whisk positioning does not modify valve dripping, spout sealing, bowl sealing, or liquid containment.
The message mentions bowl geometry only as one optional splash-control approach and does not select a new bowl capacity, depth, size, or form.
The source decision concerns whisk height during mixing and has no effect on spout location, orientation, geometry, or fabrication style.
Calibrating whisk height does not change the V1 component-sourcing strategy or the custom dispensing-spout exception.
